Tucker Carlson opens with the last scene of Orwell's Animal Farm. Pigs and men play cards together, hard to tell apart. He uses the image to judge the MAGA movement's fate.

The title warns of snakes in Washington warping the movement's meaning. Carlson argues leaders who once claimed rebellion now serve power. He asks what loyal voters should do next. The episode is a literary warning in plain form. It will speak to supporters who fear their win was stolen by the very swamp they fought. The warning lands harder for its calm tone.
